structural-causal.name: bottleneckControl
structural-causal.basis: Long-duration missile frameworks and contracts position RTX at a constrained defense-production node.

structural-causal.name: supplyChainResilience
structural-causal.basis: Capacity investment is explicit, but throughput depends on hundreds of suppliers, workforce and facilities.

structural-causal.name: scenarioRobustness
structural-causal.basis: Contracted demand supports visibility, while procurement continuity and supplier execution remain external dependencies.

discovery-weak-signals.name: defense production bottleneck
discovery-weak-signals.basis: Long-duration frameworks and rising deliveries provide source-addressed demand and capacity signals.

adversarial-red-team.name: concentrationRisk
adversarial-red-team.basis: Defense production depends materially on government procurement continuity and program priorities.

adversarial-red-team.name: supplyChainRisk
adversarial-red-team.basis: RTX explicitly identifies the need for investment across hundreds of suppliers, workforce and facilities.

adversarial-red-team.name: confidenceInflation
adversarial-red-team.basis: Delivery growth is observable, while future rate targets and economics remain prospective.

expectations-execution.name: capacity conversion
expectations-execution.basis: Higher delivered units plus long-duration contracts indicate tangible ramp progress.

expectations-execution.name: supply-chain burden
expectations-execution.basis: RTX itself states capacity expansion requires investment across workforce, technology, facilities and hundreds of suppliers.

items.risk: Production expansion depends on supplier capacity, workforce, facilities and government procurement continuity.
